methods.label: Use the function definition
methods.explanation: A function requires each \(x\) to correspond to exactly one \(y\). Two square roots, \(y^2=x\), and “any one” all fail to give a unique value.
methods.levelReason: The definition of a function and elementary square-root facts suffice.
